evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as distinct categories of value — a proportionality framing that distinguishes what is held from what is leased, enacting market-pricing logic without performing hierarchy or reciprocity.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Labels perspective as an asset — commodity/asset proportionality that ranks what to retain versus what is fungible, a market-pricing allocation of value.
